<!-- pr-reviewer: 0a54c94dbc0ae30b9d8182121e159ad8fbd01da8 -->

Ready for the maintainer to merge (screenshots still owed, see below).

## What looks good
- Native behaviour is unchanged by reading: `save` still writes the same text (`project::save_text`, `crates/app/src/project/wire.rs`), and `post_setup` / `post_script_as` still write only after the gate and engine pass; a failed write still removes the partial file (`write_program`, `crates/app/src/posting.rs`). The browser path reuses the same gate (`post_setup_unwritten`), so a refused post offers nothing.
- The browser law is in `State`, not in the drawing code. `State::run` calls `refused_in_browser` before the unsaved prompt (`crates/ui/src/state.rs`), so a greyed action is refused through the command path, not just hidden. Ribbon cells and page buttons are also greyed with the reason as the tip (`browser_files::button`, `button_sized`). Direct file calls refuse on the status line (`refuse_in_browser`). `browser_build` is `false` on native, so none of this changes the desktop.
- `browser_files::refusal` is one table with a unit test covering each refused command.
- No new dependency; decision file present; `Refs #1431` is correct because open paths stay owed to #1314.

## Results merged with main
On the self-hosted runner: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43530842326 (merged with main be27a4c7e), conclusion success. Quick gate: app suites ok, ui suites ok, 0 failed. Clippy on camcraft-app and camcraft-ui, all targets, -D warnings: clean. No Windows-only readings in the diff, so no local run.

## Not exercised (still holds)
- The `#[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]` half of `crates/ui/src/browser_files.rs` (Blob, `URL.createObjectURL`, hidden anchor click, `window.prompt`) has not been compiled by this review or by the runner (native Linux build only). The PR body says it was never compiled, and nothing since the merges of main changes that. Whether `web_sys` has the Blob, HtmlElement, Document and BlobPropertyBag features through eframe's feature set is unverified; the first compile is the next `web/build-app-wasm.sh` run or the cut. It was not run in a real browser either.
- Head 0a54c94d is one merge of main on c834e404; its only hand-resolved file is `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs` (both `mod` lines kept). Main's side does not touch `browser_files.rs`, `state_browser.rs` or `posting.rs`.
- No screenshots yet, owed to the maintainer per the PR body (File ribbon and greyed page buttons on wasm).

## Requested before merge
None.

## Notes (not blocking)
- Context-menu rows and the theme dropdown's Browse row refuse on the status line only, not greyed; the decision file says so.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Question (not blocking): main now has a native file drop (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/file_drop.rs`, #1450) that reads `dropped_files` paths and is not in the browser refusal table; on wasm a drop has no path. Please confirm it refuses cleanly there.
